children: OriginTrail is preparing the NeuroSymbolic Marketplace for live use, with the marketplace deploying on the core protocol testnet ahead of its mainnet release. The testnet deployment lets participants exercise the marketplace's AI inference flows before settlement moves on-chain. Both the testnet rollout and the mainnet release are slated for October 2026, placing the marketplace's transition to protocol status within a single month.

The marketplace is designed to run an AI inference economy denominated in TRAC, so its move to mainnet is where real token settlement flows begin. Until then, testnet activity validates the mechanics without carrying economic weight.
For observers, the October mainnet release is the point to watch, since it converts the marketplace from a test environment into live protocol infrastructure handling TRAC payments.
